title: Crossed Wires
description: Simulate logic gates and find swapped wires in a ripple-carry adder.
writeup:
## Approach

A circuit of AND, OR, and XOR gates processes x/y input bits and produces z output bits.

## Part 1

Simulate all gates: repeatedly evaluate gates whose inputs are known until all wires (including z-wires) have values. Read the z-wires as a binary number.

## Part 2

The circuit is supposed to be a ripple-carry adder with 4 pairs of swapped output wires. Instead of brute-forcing swaps, analyse the circuit structure against the expected adder pattern:
- XOR gates on x/y inputs produce intermediate sums, which should feed into another XOR (not directly to z)
- AND gates should feed into OR gates (for carry propagation)
- Only XOR gates with non-x/y inputs should output to z-wires

Any gate violating these rules has a swapped output.
